searchText: <@!273808422753796097> any idea/plan when the secret setup will be performed for eth, it could be an altogether independent event, that wouldn't mandate its use in any of the use cases (that can happen at their own pace), but will make it available as an option to be used if any experimental features would want to use them? Likely something like half a year to a year from now? I think we will only need a fairly small setup for DAS and Verkle; something like size 2**16 should be enough, so it would be doable in browser and we can get lots of participants but why not plan for 2^32, span the whole space, i can see how it can be used for e.g. in the draft EIP 3584 2**32 setups are much harder to get many participants for; seems riskier to make consensus dependent on them I remember participating in a 2**28 setup with my own implementation and it took several days on my laptop how many entropy bits would one need to accumulate for 2**k? of the same order? What do you mean by entropy bits? Like, how much local randomness each participant has to generate? That would be 256 bits in all cases... for `[s]` several days is not a bad tradeoff for setup generation 😛 just an opinion the problem is that the participant count will be lower, it would be much harder to get multiple implementations I think layer 2 applications that need the big setup can always just make their own understood it's easy to prove equivalence between commitments that use different setups so you can still bridge I just worry that "trusted setups" as a whole are still viewed suspiciously by many, and so it's worth it to be careful and make sure there's one that anyone who's very suspicious can trivially join themselves by just opening a webpage for consensus layer yea many people won't leave their systems running for several days, 2^16 how much do you estimate it will take on a laptop? It's 2**16 ECMULs, should be doable in under a minute And a few minutes in browser wow, that could definitely work!
